args.name: path
args.doc: A page of the site: /, /modules, /modules/<module id>, /tax, /customers, /pricing, /book-demo.

moves.doc: Open a page of the site, ringing the link that leads there first.

args.name: thing
args.doc: A section by its spoken name: pain points, modules, tax showcase, customer quotes, new regime slabs, old regime slabs, worked example, deductions, PF ESI PT, TDS and Form 16, plans, calculator, FAQ, calendar, booking form.

moves.say: {show: tax showcase} at the start of the sentence about a section of the page in front; it scrolls there and is ringed.
moves.doc: Scroll to a section of the page in front and ring it. Refused with the sections the page has.

args.name: id
args.doc: A module id: payroll, employees, leave, payslips, tax, compliance, reimbursements, declarations, multi_entity, api.

moves.say: {module: declarations} at the start of the sentence about one module; its card is ringed.
moves.doc: Ring one module card on the page in front (the home page's grid or the modules page).

args.name: ids
args.doc: Module ids that fit what the visitor said, in the order they came up.

moves.doc: Ring each module card in turn and mark it 'Fits your team'. Replaces the marked set.

args.name: value
args.doc: The field's value: a name, a number, a tool id, a plan id, an email the visitor confirmed.

args.name: items
args.doc: For states and pains: the full list, state names or pain ids.

moves.doc: Fill one field of the lead card on the home page, ringing it first. Opens the card when it is closed.

args.name: modules
args.doc: Module ids beyond the plan's core six, ticked on the calculator.

moves.doc: Set the pricing calculator's controls one by one (headcount, each module checkbox, billing, the filing add-on), ringing each control that changes, then ring the breakdown. Opens /pricing first when the visitor is elsewhere.

moves.say: {line: minimum} at the start of the sentence about one line of the price breakdown; that line is ringed.
moves.doc: Ring one line of the calculator's breakdown.

args.name: day
args.doc: A business day on the calendar, YYYY-MM-DD.

moves.doc: Select a day on the sales calendar (opening /book-demo first when needed) and ring its free slots.
Select one free slot on the calendar, ringing it first. Refused for a taken slot, with the free ones.
Fill one field of the booking form, ringing it first.
Press Confirm booking, after the visitor said yes. Refused, naming what is missing, while the form is incomplete.

slices.doc: the page the visitor is on
the lead card on the home page, as filled so far

fields.name: modules
fields.doc: Module cards marked as a fit.

slices.doc: the pricing calculator's controls and the plan they give

fields.name: monthly
fields.doc: The monthly fee before GST, in rupees.

slices.doc: the demo booking: the day in front, the slot picked, which form fields hold something, and the reference once confirmed

events.note: {by} set the calculator to {headcount} employees, {billing} billing: {plan}, {monthly} a month before GST

events.ask: The visitor confirmed the demo booking themselves. Thank them, say the reference and that an invite is on its way, in one line.
